title: A Postcard for the Promise Again
author: P. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Dominic Thornbury, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
